purpose: Teach: 短歌/防水/漁船/対岸/華人/バード/初演/見渡す

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さん、本気で、短歌、絶対、好きなんだよね、ぼく、本気で、教えてもらいたい、絶対、本気、本気で、本当に、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Mom, Dad—I really, really want you to teach me tanka. I'm serious. I really want to learn.
lines.style: Urgent, breathless excitement. Opens on a rush—no pause between names. Builds intensity with each repetition of "really," like he's trying to convince them of something important. Leans forward. Earnest, not playful.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お父さんの傘、本気で、防水で、絶対、雨でも、平気だってよ、翔くん、本気で、すごいわね、絶対、本当に、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. Your father's umbrella—it really does keep the rain out perfectly. That's impressive, Sho, isn't it?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone. Speaks gently, like she's affirming something he cares about. Slight lift at the end—inviting him to share the discovery with her. Unhurried, maternal attention.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 夏休み、ぼく、本気で、漁船、絶対、見たいよ、ママ、お祖父ちゃんち、本気で、行きたい、絶対、本気、本気で、お願い、絶対。
lines.en: During summer break, I really want to see the fishing boats, Mom. Can we go to Grandpa's? Please? I really want to.
lines.style: Quickened pace, almost dancing around the words. Hope and anticipation layered through—he's testing whether this might actually be possible. Not whining; genuine desire. Eyes bright. Sits up straighter.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 川の対岸、本気で、絶対、橋を渡って、行けるのよ、翔くん、家族で、行きましょうね、本気で、絶対、本気、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: We can cross the bridge over to the other side of the river, you know. We should go as a family, Sho. It'll be wonderful.
lines.style: Soft certainty. She's not asking him; she's gently deciding with him. Warm, unhurried delivery. The kind of mother-voice that makes a child feel held. Slight smile underneath the words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、華人のお友達、いるんだって、ぼく、本気で、会ってみたいよ、絶対、本気、本気で、お願い、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Your father has a Chinese friend, apparently. I'd really like to meet them, Dad. Is that possible? Please?
lines.style: Curious, slightly conspiratorial tone—like he's recruiting Dad as an ally. Open, wondering. Not demanding. There's vulnerability under the eagerness—wanting to connect with something new. Hopeful uptick at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 夏休み、本気で、絶対、バードウォッチング、家族で、絶対、行きたいわね、翔くん、本気で、楽しみ、本気、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: During summer break, I really want us to go bird-watching as a family. Don't you think that would be fun, Sho?
lines.style: Bright, inviting energy. She's painting a picture for him—not commanding, but offering. Light, almost conspiratorial. She's including him in the joy of the plan, not telling him about it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 文化祭の初演、本気で、絶対、お父さんと、ママに、来てもらいたいよ、本気で、約束、絶対、本気、本気で、本当に、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: At the school festival—I really want you and Mom to come to the premiere. You promised, remember?
lines.style: Sincere, almost solemn weight. The word "promised" lands firmly—he's holding them to something that matters to him. Quieter than before, more vulnerable. This isn't casual. Steady eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 山の頂上、本気で、絶対、街、見渡すこと、できるわよ、翔くん、家族で、絶対、登りたいわね、本気で、本気、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: From the mountaintop, you can see the whole town spread out below. We should climb it together as a family, Sho. Really.
lines.style: Tender, almost dreamy quality. She's painting the image for him—unhurried, present. Warm close-proximity voice. The repetition of "really" carries affection, not urgency. She's savoring this moment with him.
